about: C6a Steam Settings (SET §5, PLAN §1.7 row 'Settings hero icon, account avatar': +10 mm, decorative crop, both profiles). The hero's 60 px colour circle (.DialogHeader::before, drawn only while wp.c6a T2 has keyed the page and measured its title: [data-lgs-hero] on the dialog root; an absolute ::before, which P6 can crop) pops +10 mm as a non-interactive crop over a liquid slab with the hole's contact shadow. Admission: covered by the window cover (bare glass above the first platter), no focusable intersects it (decorative: rule 2 sets no cap), 60 x 60 (rule 5), never over media, not destructive, dropped while the page scrolls or a modal is open (rule 6). Menus, alerts and sheets opened from settings pages are C1c's (22-presentations.json); the list page stays at 0 (PLAN §1.12). Behind wp.c6a.
